name: Metztli
subtitle: Sanctuary of Night
description: Channel the cycle of the moon restoring your allies HP and spreading buffs throughout your team.
lore: Like the moon itself, the Omeyocan lunar goddess is a being of multiple facets. Relatively benevolent, she aids Quetzalcoatl in his endeavors to end the War of Pyramids while spreading the ways of their pantheon to Aaru. Yet ironically as a goddess of magic, she also wishes to expand her dominion over the sorcerers of other realms, and is not choosy about how.
divinity_generator: Gain [60] Divinity when placing a [Buff] on an ally.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Heal Multiplier +30%, Divinity Multiplier +20%, DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%
Awaken the ability: Cycle of Dusk
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Weapon Multiplier +30%, Armor Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Endless Night
skills.description: Restore 20% of the target’s Destroyed HP when they receive a [Buff].
skills.awakening_bonus: When this hero uses an ability, spread 1 random [buff] from this hero to all allies.

skills.name: Cycle of Dusk
skills.description:
Remove 2 random [Debuff] from all allies then place [Block Debuff] on each target for 2 turns.
Also Heal all allies.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also place [RES Up II] on each target for 2 turns and all [Buff] cannot be removed.

skills.name: Cycle of Dawn
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy and restore 20% Destroyed HP of the ally with the most Destroyed HP.

skills.name: Twilight Eclipse
skills.description: Revives all defeated allies with 40% Health and Turn Meter. Also restores 50% of each ally’s Destroyed HP and increase their Divinity by 20%.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also place [Vanish] on all allies except this hero for 2 turns.

imprint_passive: Restore 10% of this hero's Destroyed HP when they receive a [Buff].
